t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to find the colors that provide the most mushrooms and when it seems that there may be less mushrooms being gained, switch colors to get a higher amount.

vb_textbox.text: After going through and picking gnomes a few times, it seemed that the advice was correct. The pink, red, purple and brown gnomes gave points the most often. Sometimes green would be a successful pick but other times it would not be. The best combination is up to you and can change randomly between the rounds it seems.
